prisoner.name: Gullit Eder Acevedo
prisoner.description: Gullit Eder Acevedo, known as Jaguar, is an educator and street-vendor advocate associated with the Justice 8. He was arrested in December 2023 over alleged conduct at protests and detained before obtaining bail. In January 2024, a judge dismissed most charges and reduced the remaining assault charge to a misdemeanor.

cases.charges: Protest-related assault and related felony allegations; felony charges dismissed, with misdemeanor assault remaining in January 2024
cases.sentence: Pretrial detention beginning December 14, 2023, continuing through at least December 26. Later released on conditional bail; exact release date is unresolved. December 2024 reporting anticipated dismissal of the remaining misdemeanor, but final disposition has not been verified. No custodial sentence is established.

entries.custody_evidence: The sheriff release establishes December 14 booking; KVCR courthouse reporting on December 26 explicitly identifies Acevedo among the eight still in custody, followed by the December 28 bail hearing.
entries.research_notes: No DOB is inferred from age 30. The late-December bail order and later January release report do not establish an exact release day. The bail order is not treated as proof of same-day release. The six codefendant plea agreements are not assigned to Acevedo. High Desert Detention Center is named in the source but no matching institution exists in the live lookup, so no institution is invented. Coordinates are approximate Victorville locality, not a home or jail address. Source-only day totals and unresolved disposition stay in case text.
